main.description: Objection filed by an Adherent SBT holder against a Council candidate application. Per ADR-2605192300 §1. Three (3) objections from distinct SBT holders during the 30-day window triggers founder re-proposal for that seat. Public record.

applicationUri.description: AT URI of the com.etzhayyim.apps.etzhayyim.council-candidate-application being objected to.

objectorDid.description: Objector's DID. Must control an active Adherent SBT (AdherentRegistry.isActive).

objectorSbtTokenId.description: Objector's Adherent SBT tokenId. Each SBT can file at most one objection per application.

objectionGrounds.description: Category of objection. Specific gravity weighting may apply when triaging founder re-proposal trigger.

objectionNarrative.description: Detailed objection. Public + permanent record. Defamatory or evidence-free objections themselves may trigger Council Lv6+ review of the objector under the same Charter Compliance framework.

evidenceUris.description: Optional supporting evidence URIs (URL / IPFS CID / AT URI).

objectorSignature.description: DID-bound signature over (applicationUri, objectionGrounds, objectionNarrative) digest.

founderResponseUri.description: Optional founder response (re-proposal, dismissal with rationale, or referral to adherent-wide vote per ADR-2605192300 Open Question 2).
